hooks.message: For an unknown AppWorld API or print tool name, use mcp__environment__execute and place the Python call inside its code argument; do not call apis.* or print(...) as a separate tool.

prompt_rules.text: Before an irreversible Amazon order or account mutation, reconcile current mutable state with documented reads: inspect the cart, remove anything not requested, add only the requested products and quantities, and validate inventory, price, delivery, payment, and applicable discount constraints. If an operation sends or requires a one-time code, inspect the indicated email or text-message source, paginate until an empty page, and use only the retrieved code; do not guess or retry unvalidated candidates. After the side effect, verify the resulting order or account state before completion. For read-only work or already-clean state, proceed without unnecessary discovery.

skills.body:
Procedure:
1. Use mcp__environment__execute, not a direct apis.* tool call. Its code argument is Python; for example, print(apis.api_docs.show_app_descriptions()) or print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='...', api_name='...')).
2. Read the printed app-level descriptions and exact endpoint schema. Do not infer documentation is absent from a heading or an unprinted return value.
3. Record supported parameters, required fields, response shape, and pagination. Use only documented filters.
4. If a target is absent from the first page, advance through documented pagination rather than repeating the same call or guessing IDs.
5. Before a side effect, compare generic and relation-specific operations. Choose the operation that matches the source object's scope and lifecycle, such as updating or consuming an existing email, thread, or draft rather than creating a new object.
6. Verify the resulting state with documented reads before completion.
Stop early when the contract and target object are already resolved; do not force rediscovery.
skills.description: Resolve AppWorld API contracts through the environment execute tool before selecting or calling an endpoint, especially when documentation output is silent or a generic operation could replace a relation-specific one.
skills.name: contract-preflight
skills.when_to_use: Use before first relying on an unfamiliar app or endpoint, after a documentation call renders no useful output, or before choosing between generic and relation-specific operations. Stop once the exact contract and target object are already resolved.

examples: Before an Amazon order, inspect the current cart. If it contains anything not requested, clear it, add only the requested products and quantities, then re-inspect before ordering.
When an operation says it sent a code, inspect the indicated email or text-message source and paginate until an empty page before using the code; never guess or retry an unvalidated candidate.

Use mcp__environment__execute for AppWorld APIs: its code argument is Python. Before a filtered search, run code such as print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='...', api_name='...')) and use only documented parameters; never call apis.* or print(...) as a separate tool.
